status: candidate framework; not a validated core outcome set

authorship.status: tentative; not an assertion of author approval

domains.principle: Keep baseline, nadir, serial and confirmatory evidence distinct; early rise is not a prospective flare label.
Separate lesion observations, whole-body burden, RECIST response, PCWG progression and RECIP response.
Dose is an exposure. Link target-specific estimates to response and toxicity without treating association as causation.

domains.domain: Clinical benefit, safety, function and patient-reported outcomes
domains.principle: Capture actual events and repeated instruments; separate clinician grading, patient reporting and course completion.
First progression, NLCB, last administration, planned completion, next treatment and retreatment are distinct events.

priority_policy: Source priority is an annotation, not a globally required property or an assertion of validation.
